document.title: H1-H4 deletion-safety patch — clean-base verification
document.base_subject: docs: record D-69 canary result and operator packet
document.author: Buffy (Freebuff)

patch.revision: v1.1 (adds the missing worktree-name fixture rename)

apply.method: git apply --check then git apply in a dedicated worktree at the base commit
apply.pythonpath: the worktree's own src/, so the repo-root editable install cannot shadow the patched tree

notes: The two suites are collected separately because tests/pmk and tests/fleet both ship a top-level conftest.py, so a combined collection fails (OQ-06).
This is a focused clean-base record for the patch, not the PDD section 6 full gate. The full gate at 06d3e93 (1131 passed) and the red gate at 4e72901 are recorded separately on T-0189.
The patch excludes the unrelated worktree-cwd one-liner in harness.py and the REC-02 binary/CRLF restore-proof tests.
An earlier fleet run in this worktree was interrupted by the command timeout after one test failed; the complete rerun above finished green. The interrupted run's partial output is not evidence.
